requirements.id: install.troubleshooting.Dependency errors.... has no git tag satisfying <range>
requirements.note: Own-repository dependency with no <name>--v tag in range fails the install with `Dependency "<dep>" has no git tag satisfying <ranges>`; a relative-path dependency installs the current copy instead (§16.25).
Exact `Dependency "<dep>" is disabled — enable it or remove the dependency`, errorType dependency-unsatisfied; a --plugin-dir copy names itself <name>@inline.

requirements.note: Documented text without Claude Code 2.1.322's ` — run claude plugin install ...` suffix, which J16.24 permits a client to add or omit (agent-plugins spec/judgments.md:1315); errorType dependency-unsatisfied.

requirements.id: marketplace.troubleshooting.Cannot add marketplace "<name>": Claude Code reserves this name and cannot register a marketplace under it
requirements.evidence: src/format/marketplace/marketplace-names.ts:176 (memberIssues, in loadNameIssues only), src/format/marketplace/marketplace.ts:57 (validate uses validationNameIssues), src/format/marketplace/marketplace-source.ts:133 (settings-declared); tests/format/marketplace/marketplace-names.test.ts:222
requirements.note: The seven JavaScript member names pass validation and are refused at add and at settings load with the exact text.

The kit gives the exact message and guesses no source (fix only for claude-plugins-official and claudeai- names). Raising it from /plugin install and on the Errors tab for an enabled plugin naming an unadded marketplace is the host's UI; the kit has no load-time producer for the latter.
`Failed to add marketplace: Marketplace file not found at <path>`, the path given by the host (default or the source's path).
Error at the entry's source path, `Path contains "..": <raw>`.

requirements.id: mcp.troubleshooting.Bundled MCP server "<name>" was not started: it needs configuration
requirements.note: Required setting without a saved value (empty string counts as none) skips that server only, and saved values let it start. Two kit judgments: a required setting with its own default does not block; the bundle's own validation of saved values is the host's (agent-plugins spec/judgments.md:679).
